result.instructions: Tools for StoreFeeder, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are ready to pick in StoreFeeder, and which warehouse holds them?"; "How much stock do we hold for SKU ABC-123 across all stock locations?"; "Show the inventory log for product 4521 in November.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StoreFeeder data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run storefeeder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run storefeeder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run storefeeder_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. storefeeder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current API user
tools.description: Return the API user this connection uses: name, email, last login and admin status. Also the cheapest connection check. GET /users/me.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_channels
tools.title: List sales channels
tools.description: List the sales channels (marketplaces and shops) on the account with their type and active flag. Use the ChannelID in order and listing searches. GET /channels.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses on the account, with the default warehouse flag and sender details. Use the WarehouseID in other searches. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_stock_locations
tools.title: List stock locations
tools.description: List stock locations (bins and shelves), optionally for one warehouse or one SKU. GET /stocklocations.

sku.description: Only locations holding this product SKU.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers on the account with currency, code and minimum order value. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses used in StoreFeeder, with a description of each. Use the names in order searches. GET /order-status.

tools.name: storefeeder_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search products by SKU, EAN, warehouse, supplier or last change date. Returns product records with stock. GET /products.

warehouse_id.description: Only products stocked in this warehouse.

modified_from.description: Only products changed on or after this date.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Return one product by its StoreFeeder product ID, with all its data (suppliers, stock locations, barcodes). GET /products/{productid}.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_product_inventory_logs
tools.title: Get product inventory log
tools.description: Return the inventory change log of one product in a UTC date range: who changed stock, when and why. GET /products/{productid}/productinventorylogs.

from.description: Only logs created after this UTC date.

to.description: Only logs created before this UTC date.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_warehouse_inventory
tools.title: Get warehouse inventory report
tools.description: Return every product in one warehouse with its current inventory, one page at a time. GET /warehouses/{warehouseID}/inventory-report.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_listings
tools.title: List channel listings
tools.description: List the marketplace listings (product offers on a channel) with price, status and channel identifier. GET /listings.

channel_id.description: Only listings on this channel (see storefeeder_list_channels).

product_sku.description: Only listings for this product SKU.

listing_sku.description: Only listings with this channel SKU.

created_from.description: Only listings created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Only listings created on or before this date.

tools.name: storefeeder_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders to suppliers, filtered by raised date, supplier, warehouse or status. GET /purchase-orders.

raised_from.description: Raised on or after this date.

raised_to.description: Raised on or before this date.

tools.name: storefeeder_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders by date, status, channel, warehouse or tracking number. Customer names, addresses, emails and phone numbers are not returned. GET /orders.

downloaded.description: Only orders marked downloaded (true) or not downloaded (false).

order_date_from.description: Ordered on or after this date.

order_date_to.description: Ordered on or before this date.

last_status_change_from.description: Status changed on or after this date.

last_status_change_to.description: Status changed on or before this date.

shipping_tracking_number.description: Only orders with this tracking number.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Return one order by its StoreFeeder order number: lines, status, totals and tracking. Customer names, addresses, emails and phone numbers are not returned. GET /orders/{ordernumber}.

tools.name: storefeeder_get_order_logs
tools.title: Get order log
tools.description: Return the change history of one order: who changed what, from which value to which, and when. Old and new values of address, email, phone and customer changes are shown as [removed]. GET /orders/{ordernumber}/logs.

tools.name: storefeeder_adjust_stock
tools.title: Adjust stock (relative)
tools.description: Change the stock of one product by a relative amount (plus or minus units), optionally in one stock location, with a reason. This changes live inventory. PUT /products/{productid}/stocklocationinventory.

stock_location_id.description: Stock location reference, for example A-1. Omit for the unspecified location.

reason.description: Reason written to the inventory log.

tools.name: storefeeder_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: Add a note with a subject and body to one order. The note stays on the order. PATCH /orders/{orderNumber}/notes. Note type: OrderQuery (the value in the vendor docs).

note_type.description: Order note type. The vendor docs example is OrderQuery.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with StoreFeeder
prompts.description: What you can do with StoreFeeder here, with example requests to try.
